Maintains the 2-1/4 to 2-1/2 percent target range and signals patience amid strong labor markets and solid activity, with inflation running below 2 percent. The May 2019 Financial Stability Report notes equity market volatility had spiked previously but had declined by May, while still flagging financial stability concerns. Net tone is cautiously positive but tempered by muted inflation and lingering risks.
